text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after training.
I was planning on clearing out all the
backlogged work tonight, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I... can't move a single step from here anymore...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I declare the trainer's office...
Sei-chan's official nap spot...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
Goodbyeee...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously.
Peeking at my sleeping face is a violation of the Sei-chan Code...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Please come wake me up...
in two hours..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I was kicked out. Having no other choice, I decided to look around town. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The entire town looked completely different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So I scrambled to pick out a Christmas
present for Seiun Sky, and when I got
back to the academy two hours later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The interior had completely changed from usual...!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmaaas☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha, were you surprised~?
Christmas surprise: massive success~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Sei-chan put up
all these little decorations all by herself~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's Christmas,
a certain Trainer looked like they were still gonna keep working, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I mean, to begin with, it felt like she didn't even notice~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I made it a surprise☆
Tee-hee♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Paying close attention to seasonal events
is a requirement of any good Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Making the Umamusume in your care worry about you...
That makes you a naughty Trainer, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...Well, the look of surprise on your face was hilarious, so it's fine♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Byyy the waaay~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're holding a bag I haven't seen before... What is that...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I knew it~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, I kneeeew you'd have it ready
for me, Trainer-san!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I trusted her and sent her out there☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what're you gonna give me?
Give me a hint, a hint!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we enjoyed a quiz game to guess
the Christmas presents for a while...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's not the only surprise
I've got up my sleeve♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, turn off the lights!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that!
Hurry, hurry~♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks.
Alright, here I go~ ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Across the ceiling, the walls, and the floor...
What spread out everywhere was a field of stars.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Merry Christmas, once again.
My present to you is this starry sky!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's too early to get emotional.
Take a look over there—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the direction Seiun Sky pointed,
there shone an exceptionally bright star.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—That's the other present.
Now then, let's go catch a star!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled along by Seiun Sky, I head toward the light.
And then, gradually enveloped in the brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Look inside your hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I open my hand, which I had unconsciously clenched tight. And there, I saw...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...acrylic ice, that is.
Turns out the star I caught was a fake~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Sei-chan is still just a kid.
This is about my limit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, a star like that...
isn't half bad, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With the right staging, maybe we can sparkle!?
...is what the brilliant Director Sky realized.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, eheh.
Maybe that was a bit too cheap, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I actually borrowed that home planetarium from someone else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
From high hopes to a huge letdown...
...Did that happen to you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really?
choice_data_list: It's the most beautiful star I've ever seen.
It's the most beautiful star I've ever seen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then let's call today a huge success!
Though someday, you know—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You want to catch a real star, right?
I'll come up with a strategy♪
